tool.name: AddLayersForUniqueValues
tool.summary: Create a new feature layer in the active map for each unique value found in a specified field. Useful for quickly exploring Overture data by class, subtype, or category.

usage.bullet_item: Select a feature layer already added to the active map and choose a field to split on.
One definition-query layer is created per unique value and added to the current map.
This tool must be run inside ArcGIS Pro with an active map.

param.name: input_layer
param.dialogReference: The feature layer in the active map to create unique-value layers from.

param.name: field_name
param.dialogReference: The field whose unique values will each generate a new layer. Geometry and OID fields are excluded from the list.
